_comment: The indicator series pulled per country. Kept deliberately short: every series here is injected into the model prompt, so each one must earn its tokens by changing an answer. `meaning` is what the model is told the number represents — write it so a number alone cannot be misread.

worldbank.label: GDP per capita
worldbank.meaning: Average income level. Anchors pricing and willingness to pay.

worldbank.label: GDP per capita, PPP
worldbank.meaning: Income adjusted for local prices. Better than nominal for judging affordability.

worldbank.label: GDP growth
worldbank.meaning: Direction of the economy. A growth assumption above this needs justifying.

worldbank.label: Inflation
worldbank.meaning: Consumer price inflation. Cost lines and price lists must account for it.

worldbank.label: Population
worldbank.meaning: Total addressable population — a ceiling, never a market size.

worldbank.label: Urban population
worldbank.meaning: How concentrated customers are. Drives distribution and logistics cost.

worldbank.label: Internet users
worldbank.meaning: Hard ceiling on any purely online model.

worldbank.label: Mobile subscriptions
worldbank.meaning: Reach of mobile channels, including mobile money.

worldbank.label: Access to electricity
worldbank.meaning: Operational constraint. Low values imply generator or solar cost lines.

worldbank.label: Domestic credit to private sector
worldbank.meaning: How available bank financing realistically is. Low values mean self-funding or informal credit.

worldbank.label: Rule of law
worldbank.meaning: Contract enforceability and property rights. Low values raise the cost of every agreement.

worldbank.label: Control of corruption
worldbank.meaning: Likelihood of informal payments being demanded. Affects timelines and budget.

worldbank.label: Regulatory quality
worldbank.meaning: How workable the rules are for private business.

worldbank.label: Government effectiveness
worldbank.meaning: Quality of public services a business depends on — registration, utilities, courts.

worldbank.label: Political stability
worldbank.meaning: Continuity risk. Low values justify shorter planning horizons.

hdr.label: Human Development Index
hdr.meaning: Composite of health, education and income.

hdr.label: Expected years of schooling
hdr.meaning: Skill availability in the workforce to come.

hdr.label: Mean years of schooling
hdr.meaning: Skill availability in the workforce today. Constrains how much training a plan must budget for.

hdr.label: Gender Inequality Index
hdr.meaning: Lower is more equal. Relevant to workforce access and to products serving women.

hdr.label: Inequality-adjusted HDI
hdr.meaning: HDI discounted for inequality. The gap against HDI shows how unevenly income is spread.
